name: P-006 / R-12 live unprovable-wait backfill reading on the operator database (event-wait-settlement-2026-10-20)
summary: The R-12 probe (docs/evidence/ews-p006-r12-backfill-live/probe.sql) read every active event/gate wait on a non-terminal papercusp-workspace item and returned 405|345|51|9|0|0|300|0|0: 405 active wait(s) = 345 with a re-check date + 51 on a concrete condition-proving key + 9 on a live announced key + 0 on an already-fired announced key + 0 unprovable with no re-check date. The backfill (system:unprovable-wait-backfill) has stamped 300 row(s) across all items, cleared 0, and 0 stamped row(s) went inactive with no recorded clearer. The committed oracle judged it PASS. All six negative controls failed on their targeted assertion as required.

assertions.evidence: stamped=345 + proving_concrete=51 + announced_live=9 + announced_fired=0 + unprovable_unstamped=0 = 405; active_waits=405; row 405|345|51|9|0|0|300|0|0
unprovable_unstamped=0 (active event/gate rows with no re-check date that are neither a concrete condition-proving key nor announced); row 405|345|51|9|0|0|300|0|0
backfill_cleared=0 (rows whose clearedBy is system:unprovable-wait-backfill); row 405|345|51|9|0|0|300|0|0
stamped_inactive_unattributed=0 (backfill-stamped rows no longer active with no clearedBy); row 405|345|51|9|0|0|300|0|0
backfill_stamped_rows=300 (rows whose recheckSource is system:unprovable-wait-backfill); row 405|345|51|9|0|0|300|0|0
re-check dates ignored: a database the backfill never stamped must fail; row 405|0|53|22|8|322|300|0|0; oracle passed=false; failing assertions: no-unprovable-unstamped
live announcements ignored: an unstamped announced wait must then count as unprovable; row 405|345|51|0|0|9|300|0|0; oracle passed=false; failing assertions: no-unprovable-unstamped
concrete condition-proving keys ignored: an unstamped proving wait must then count as unprovable; row 405|345|0|9|0|51|300|0|0; oracle passed=false; failing assertions: no-unprovable-unstamped
every cleared row attributed to the backfill: the cleared-row count must be able to fail; row 405|345|51|9|0|0|300|2920|0; oracle passed=false; failing assertions: none-cleared-by-backfill
every stamped row treated as cleared with no clearer: the fail-closed count must be able to fail; row 405|345|51|9|0|0|300|0|300; oracle passed=false; failing assertions: no-unattributed-clear
the backfill actor renamed to one that never wrote: a database the backfill never reached must fail; row 405|345|51|9|0|0|0|0|0; oracle passed=false; failing assertions: backfill-observed

environment.reader: sudo -n -u postgres psql -q -At (BEGIN READ ONLY ... ROLLBACK)

limitations: One live reading, not a continuous observation: a wait written through an old build (one without wait-ref-admission) after this reading is not covered until the backfill and this probe are re-run.

Provability is decided by the probe independently of readEventConditionReachability: a concrete key of a catalog family whose fire proves the condition, or an exact live announcement. A provable wait of another shape (a predicate watch) would be reported as unprovable — fail-closed, and none exists at this reading.

The reading judges the outcome (no unprovable wait left without a re-check date, none cleared by the backfill), not the backfill code path; the code path is covered by the tree evidence bound to the same clause (work-item-blocker-reaper.test.ts and its mutation runs).

instrument.role: Every pass/fail decision on the probe rows is taken by this committed oracle; run.mjs only executes the SQL and records output. The oracle test also pins the probe's terminal-state and condition-family lists to the code.
